instruction: I often receive important emails and need to stay updated. Can you configure Thunderbird to automatically check for new mail every 5 minutes?

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring automatic mail checking in Thunderbird. The evaluator verifies three preferences: 1) mail.check_all_imap_folders_for_new is set to true to check all folders, 2) mail.server.default.check_new_mail is enabled, and 3) mail.server.default.check_time is set to 5 minutes. These are standard Thunderbird preferences that control mail checking behavior.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: auto-check enabled and 5-minute interval
Getter extracts the right state: downloads Thunderbird prefs.js file from the VM to read preferences

Metric correctly parses prefs.js format and compares three relevant preferences: mail.check_all_imap_folders_for_new (true), mail.server.default.check_new_mail (true), and mail.server.default.check_time (5)
Expected values are semantically correct for the task: enabling auto-check and setting 5-minute interval
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before reading
Metric correctly handles None result (returns 0.0 if getter fails)
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric accesses expected.get('expect', {}) which is correct because get_rule() returns config['rules'] directly when expected.type='rule'
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both enabling auto-check AND setting the correct time interval
